$comment: Machine-readable current state only. docs/ROADMAP.md owns sequence; specialist authorities own reasoning and evidence.
currentStage: Phase 4.4 — product proof through high-value application capability
blockedBy: No engineering blocker. The second genuine-business case is owner-blocked on approved facts and explicit asset-level usage rights; that does not block the serious-application, quality-integrity or release tracks.
nextStage: Advance Phase 4.4 through the four outcome tracks in docs/ROADMAP.md: close bounded quality-truth gaps, run the owner-blocked second genuine-business case when approved inputs arrive, prove one bounded serious-application slice, and establish accepted-build release promotion. New capabilities are pulled only by those outcomes or a demonstrated reusable defect.
outstandingProductGates: quality-truth-closure: derived requirement coverage remains open.
second-genuine-business-proof: MGB Decor requires owner-approved facts and asset-level usage rights before replayable intake can be frozen.

bounded-serious-application-benchmark: the first Predictor-class vertical slice has not run; it must prove decision, authoritative lock, official result, settlement, score and leaderboard without football-specific factory abstractions.

accepted-build-release-lifecycle: no real generated product has proved explicit promotion of an identified accepted revision/artifact through production smoke verification, release record and rollback target.
visual-maturity: unpaid and deferred; best independent mean 6.55 and floor 4.8 against required 8.5/6.5. It must pass before any best-in-class visual or proven-website claim.

deferredCapabilities.title: Professional visual quality
deferredCapabilities.reason: Measured and failed; one business is insufficient to generalise the fixed component-vocabulary hypothesis.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: Several materially different projects show a cross-project ceiling; a real consumer needs direction-selectable component implementations; before any visual-maturity claim; or materially new evidence appears.

unpaidGate.finding: The Presentation Registry changes tokens and presentations but not component vocabulary, constraining distinctiveness.

deferredCapabilities.title: Static-renderer visual parity
deferredCapabilities.reason: Measured at mean 5.38 and floor 2.0 while carrying the default shell; engineering correctness is proven, visual parity is not.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A visual direction is promoted and the static renderer can be reviewed carrying it.

unpaidGate.finding: The static renderer was reviewed carrying the default shell because no visual direction had been promoted.

deferredCapabilities.title: Deterministic design-intelligence catalogue
deferredCapabilities.reason: No current consumer asks a question requiring it.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real design consumer cannot answer a project, industry or intent pattern question from existing deterministic configuration.

deferredCapabilities.title: MessagingPlan
deferredCapabilities.reason: Composition already carries current narrative, CTA, audience, proof-gap and provenance decisions.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real composition or art-direction decision needs information current composition cannot express.

deferredCapabilities.title: Visual comparison canvas
deferredCapabilities.reason: The Console comparison surface handles the current task.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A concrete review needs spatial arrangement or annotation the Console cannot provide.

deferredCapabilities.title: Additional static-renderer capabilities
deferredCapabilities.reason: Semantic icons, Pagefind, richer typed data and deterministic OG imagery have no current consumer.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A corpus project records the absence as a real defect.

deferredCapabilities.title: CMS and content collections
deferredCapabilities.reason: Genuinely unbuilt; no current project needs owner-edited post-handover content.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real project needs editorial content its owner will change after handover.

deferredCapabilities.title: Localisation
deferredCapabilities.reason: Genuinely unbuilt; the existing NFR field has no renderer or composition consumer.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real project publishes in a second language.

deferredCapabilities.title: Design/Figma import
deferredCapabilities.reason: Genuinely unbuilt and not a solution to the fixed component-vocabulary finding.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real project supplies a design file as authority or design-system assimilation needs it.

deferredCapabilities.title: Brownfield diagnosis and mutation
deferredCapabilities.reason: Only read-only profiling is proven; it grants no mutation authority.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: An exact-revision baseline includes observed passing tests and rendered behavioural evidence sufficient to protect known-good behaviour.
